title: GFG: Rat in a Maze Problem
description: Consider a rat placed at (0, 0) in a square matrix `m` of order `n`. It has to reach destination at (n - 1, n - 1). Its directions are 'U'(up), 'D'(down), 'L'(left), 'R'(right). Value 0 means blocked, 1 means open. Return all sorted path strings.
explanation: Backtracking with visited 2D matrix explores D, L, R, U movements in sorted lexicographical order.
